description: F7 rule 6 golden: B2 alpha urgency (API_TRADING.md section 2.14): iap.execution.signal.zscore cases ([z], mean, std); iap.execution.urgency.regime_from_z cases; queries against ArraySignalSource(sources) under each AlphaUrgencyPolicy, classified as the replay does at a child decision (ExecutionReplay._reading: the last reading with ts <= t - latency_ns, stale when older than max_age_ns > 0; _signal_child: the regime is the status without a reading, else regime_from_z). The slice block derives readings from the book (readings_rule) and records their z (zscore on real data) and every query.
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`

slice.rule: a sample is taken after applying the k-th event (1-based) whenever k > prefix_events and k % sample_every == 0
slice.readings_rule: a reading after every 50th event (1-based ordinal) past the prefix whose book is two-sided: ts = the event's exchange_ts, expected_return = (bid_sz - ask_sz) / (bid_sz + ask_sz) * 1e-4 of the consolidated L1 after the event, z = iap.execution.signal.zscore over those expected returns; equal timestamps keep the last reading
slice.queries: every policy x side at every sample's exchange_ts
